caption: One play of the Chennai kiosk loop: 20 s of audio, then 15 s of video, then the 2 s blinking icon, giving 37 s of timed media. The touch button at the bottom runs across the whole loop but is a control, so it contributes no duration.

spec.aria: A timeline of one loop of the railway kiosk: a 20 s audio bar from 0 to 20 s, a 15 s video bar from 20 to 35 s, a 2 s animation bar from 35 to 37 s, and a grey touch-button bar spanning the whole 37 s with no duration of its own.
